title: Geomatics Section
text:
The Geomatics Section is part of the Forestry Students’ Scientific Association (Koło Naukowe Leśników) at the University of Agriculture in Krakow. It brings together students interested in applying geoinformatics and remote sensing in forestry.
I have been the supervisor of the Section since 2024.

title: Jakub Miszczyszyn
text:
Geoinformatics and remote sensing in forestry
Department of Forest Resources Management, Faculty of Forestry
University of Agriculture in Krakow
I work in geoinformatics, remote sensing and spatial data analysis. I support the scientific and educational activities at the University of Agriculture in Krakow and supervise the Geomatics Section of the Forestry Students’ Scientific Association.
My work combines programming in R with data acquisition using unmanned aerial vehicles, LiDAR laser scanning, and multispectral and thermal cameras.

title: Welcome to My Blog
text: Welcome to my blog! My name is Jakub Miszczyszyn, and I am currently pursuing a Ph.D. in forestry, with a strong focus on using advanced geoinformatics and remote sensing tools to better understand and manage forest ecosystems. 🌲

title: Welcome to My Blog
text:
Why This Blog?
As a researcher and forestry enthusiast, I created this blog to share insights from my academic journey and professional projects. My goal is to blend technology and environmental science, especially in areas like:

Forest ecosystem monitoring using drones, LiDAR, and multispectral cameras.
Developing innovative methods for sustainable forest management.
Sharing my personal experiences from research and teaching.

I’m currently affiliated with the University of Agriculture in Krakow, where I actively contribute to scientific and educational activities. You can explore my university profile here.

title: Welcome to My Blog
text:

title: Welcome to My Blog
text:
What’s Next?
Through this blog, I’ll dive into exciting topics such as:

The role of remote sensing in sustainable forestry.
Practical tutorials in GIS and R programming for ecological data analysis.
Reflections on my doctoral research and fieldwork in forestry.

I’m also passionate about photography and exploring the natural world through technology. Stay tuned for upcoming posts where I’ll share stories from the field and insights into my work.

Thank you for joining me on this journey! Feel free to reach out, share your thoughts, or collaborate through the links above. Let’s make sustainable forest management a reality together!
Cheers,
Jakub Miszczyszyn

title: Software
text:
3D visualization and statistical analysis of GPR-detected tree root systems · version 0.1.0 · GPL (≥ 3) licence
The package processes raw CSV exports from GPR software into spatial root segments, computes their geometric metrics (3D length, azimuth, slope, depth), links roots to tree stem positions, delineates root system extent with convex hull polygons, estimates bounding volume, and analyses root system overlap between neighbouring trees.
Developed as part of the NCN-funded project “Application of ground-penetrating radar with 3D scanner for measuring variability in Scots pine root systems”. Co-authored with Luiza Tymińska-Czabańska.
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("j-miszczyszyn/GRootR")

 Repository  Documentation

title: Software
text:
foRestools
Tools for foresters · version 1.0.3 · GPL (≥ 3) licence
A set of tools for forest data analysis and remote sensing tasks. The package includes, among others:

creating a canopy height model (CHM) from LAS files and normalizing LiDAR point cloud heights,
detecting treetops on a canopy height model,
clipping a point cloud to an area of interest (AOI) and thinning it while preserving selected classes,
calculating vegetation indices (CCI, DVI, GDVI, GSAVI, MSAVI, NDVI, TGI),
downloading the digital terrain model and orthophotos from GUGiK for large areas,
calculating new coordinates from a distance and direction.

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("j-miszczyszyn/foRestools")

 Repository

title: Bio
text:
I support the scientific and educational activities of the Department of Forest Resources Management at the Faculty of Forestry, University of Agriculture in Krakow, where I have worked since October 2023. I work in geoinformatics, remote sensing and spatial data analysis in forestry.
I hold a master’s degree in Forestry with a specialization in Geoinformatics from the University of Agriculture in Krakow (2023), preceded by engineering studies in Forestry with a specialization in Forest Management (2022). I graduated from the Forestry Technical School in Lesko (Technikum Leśne w Lesku), where I was twice awarded the Prime Minister’s Scholarship. I gained professional experience at ProGea SKY, ProGea 4D, ProGea Consulting and GISPRO.
Since 2024 I have supervised the Geomatics Section of the Forestry Students’ Scientific Association. I am a member of the IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Society (IEEE GRSS), the International Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (ISPRS), the Polish Forest Society (PTL) and the Association of Forestry and Wood Technology Engineers and Technicians (SITLiD).
